program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(true, !is_a@j)
h1_2 = leftmost(!is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j, true)
h1_3 = rightmost(!is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j, !is_bos@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(!h1_1@i & h1_2@i & h1_3@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j & !h1_1@j, !is_bos@j & !h1_1@j)
h2_2 = leftmost(h1_2@i & h1_3@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j & !h1_1@j & h1_2@j & h1_3@j, !h1_1@j)
h2_3 = rightmost(!is_b@j & !h1_1@j, !h1_2@j)
accept = h1_2 & h1_3 & h2_1 & h2_2 & !h2_3

output accept
